name: vault-secretr
description: secretr-backed KMS for the vault module: key-encryption and blind-index keys live in an encrypted secretr store, selected with vault { backend "secretr" }. Needs access to the (private) github.com/oarkflow/secretr module.
env: # vault-secretr: needs APP_VAULT_KEY (the store's master key); keys live under vault.dir in config/app.bcl
